notes.title: Welcome Rem Survival
notes.content:
Moving forward, the game will now be known as Rem Survival. The reason for this change has come from player feedback over the last 2 years, this change will also help improve the game's visibility and metrics.

The title Remnants was selected in 2015 for the game and was made known through [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161129121450/https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=808488392]Steam Greenlight[/url] on November 28, 2016, but throughout the years other games have used similar names not bothering to respect other developers or their games no matter how big or small, some might think using a similar name is fine, but it causes issues like people joining and being directed to the wrong community for that game which has happened many times, so I took it on to change the game's name for the best outcome for the future of the game.

[url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Roentgen_equivalent_man]What does REM stand for and how does it relate to the game?[/url]

[b]These changes will come into effect for the backend when the next patch is released which is due out in 2-7 days, but name and logo changes will be rolling out up until this date on all related platforms.[/b]

[b]Original Logo 2015[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32805202/3633680078beaa4a546f24738b1bd2d0a6006cdb.gif[/img]

[b]SERVERS[/b]

[b]Local Saves[/b]
This won't delete or remove any player data, but once this name change happens on the backend, people will need to rename their saved folder in documents/mygames to match the name change.

[b]Dedicated Server Saves[/b]
I will work with GPortal to port over all saved data in this process, but if you're hosting your own dedicated server you will have to move your saved folder from the old server folder to the new server folder.
